typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	RunDate as timestamp (toTimestamp('9/11/2025 1:03:12 PM')),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		WFTaskId as string,
		WFTaskName as string,
		WFTaskStageName as string,
		WFTaskDescription as string,
		WFTaskAssignedToUser as string,
		WFTaskAssignedToGroup as string,
		WFTaskResultName as string,
		WFTaskResultReason as string,
		WFTaskProposalName as string,
		{Proposal ID} as string,
		WFTaskType as string,
		WFTaskState as string,
		WFTaskCreatedBy as string,
		WFTaskCreatedDate as string,
		WFTaskModifiedBy as string,
		WFTaskModifiedDate as string,
		WFTaskActivatedBy as string,
		WFTaskActivatedDate as string,
		WFTaskCompletedBy as string,
		WFTaskCompletedDate as string,
		WFTaskCanceledBy as string,
		WFTaskCanceledDate as string,
		WFTaskDueDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Snaopshot_Asof_Date = $RunDate,
		Snapshot_Active_Flag = 'Y') ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		WFTaskAssignedToUser as string,
		WFTaskCreatedBy as string,
		WFTaskResultName as string,
		WFTaskDescription as string,
		WFTaskCompletedBy as string,
		WFTaskProposalName as string,
		WFTaskStageName as string,
		WFTaskModifiedDate as string,
		WFTaskName as string,
		SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_FLAG as string,
		WFTaskCreatedDate as string,
		WFTaskModifiedBy as string,
		WFTaskType as string,
		WFTaskResultReason as string,
		WFTaskAssignedToGroup as string,
		Proposal_ID as string,
		WFTaskState as string,
		WFTaskCompletedDate as string,
		SNAPSHOT_AS_OF_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		WFTaskCanceledBy as string,
		WFTaskId as string,
		WFTaskCanceledDate as string,
		WFTaskActivatedBy as string,
		WFTaskDueDate as string,
		WFTaskActivatedDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		WFTaskAssignedToUser,
		WFTaskCreatedBy,
		WFTaskResultName,
		WFTaskDescription,
		WFTaskCompletedBy,
		WFTaskProposalName,
		WFTaskStageName,
		WFTaskModifiedDate,
		WFTaskName,
		SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_FLAG = Snapshot_Active_Flag,
		WFTaskCreatedDate,
		WFTaskModifiedBy,
		WFTaskType,
		WFTaskResultReason,
		WFTaskAssignedToGroup,
		Proposal_ID = {Proposal ID},
		WFTaskState,
		WFTaskCompletedDate,
		SNAPSHOT_AS_OF_DATE = Snaopshot_Asof_Date,
		WFTaskCanceledBy,
		WFTaskId,
		WFTaskCanceledDate,
		WFTaskActivatedBy,
		WFTaskDueDate,
		WFTaskActivatedDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
